name: Matrix

sections.heading: Availability and maturity
sections.text: EXPERIMENTAL; evidence FROZEN_PUBLIC_SOURCE. Documentation does not promote this identity to stable. Public and owner namespaces are separate contracts.

sections.heading: Limits and lifecycle
sections.text: Authenticated selective std.scientific import reaches the current typed native constructor and method owner in default and no-prelude compilation. Exact shape/value/native boundaries remain those of the receiver-qualified Matrix/Tensor rows. The visibility host consumes import declarations only; native code compiles and executes all remaining statements and the explicit return.

sections.heading: Privacy, dependencies and authority
sections.text: Capability: NONE. Gate: NONE. Import grants capability: NO. Use synthetic local data. Hardware claim: NO. Security assurance: NO. RELEASE-LEGAL_PENDING_SEPARATE_FROM_CORE_FUNCTIONAL_PROFILE. SDK buffers and handles follow the owner lifecycle and reject invalid/released inputs where specified. No downloaded models, secrets, external network or device access is needed for the documented local proofs.
